transcript.en: Good morning everyone.
transcript.zh: 各位早上好。

transcript.en: My name's Joy Parkins and I'm the restaurant manager.
transcript.zh: 我叫Joy Parkins，是这家餐厅的经理。

transcript.en: And I understand that none of you've had any previous experience as kitchen assistants?
transcript.zh: 我知道你们之前都没有厨房助理的经验。

transcript.en: Well, you might be feeling a bit nervous now, but most of our kitchen assistants say they enjoy the work.
transcript.zh: 你们现在也许会有点紧张，但是我们厨房的大多数厨房助理都表示他们很享受这份工作。

transcript.en: OK, they might get shouted at sometimes, but it's nothing personal,
transcript.zh: 有时你会看到他们被大声的呵斥，但是这并不是针对的个人哦。

transcript.en: and they're pleased  that they have so many different things to do, which means they never get bored.
transcript.zh: 他们都很乐意有如此多样的事情做，这意味着他们一直都不会感到无聊。

transcript.en: And I'll tell you straightaway that if you do well,
transcript.zh: 而且我也可以直接告诉你们，如果你做得够好。

transcript.en: we might think about moving you up and giving you some more responsibility.
transcript.zh: 我们也会考虑给你升职，同时承担更大的责任。

transcript.en: Right, well, you've all shown up on time, which is an excellent start.
transcript.zh: 不错，你们都准时出勤了，这是一个好的开始。

transcript.en: Now I'm glad to see none of you have unsuitable footwear. so that's good- you need to be careful as the floors can get very wet and slippery.
transcript.zh: 我很高兴你们穿的鞋子都是合格的，这很不错，你们一定要小心，因为地板有时会很湿同时还很滑。

transcript.en: Those of you with long hair have got it well out of the way,
transcript.zh: 虽然你们之中那些留着长头发的已经把头发扎好了，

transcript.en: but some of you'll need to remove your rings and bracelets - just put them somewhere safe for today,
transcript.zh: 但是有些人还是需要拿掉你们的戒指和手镯，今天先把它们放到安全的地方，

transcript.en: and remember to leave them at home tomorrow, as they can be a safety hazard.
transcript.zh: 记着明天还是把它们留在家里比较安全。

transcript.en: Now it's going to be a busy day for you all today- we don't have any tables free for this evening, and only a few for lunch.
transcript.zh: 现在开始你们将会忙碌一整天了，因为我们今晚已经没有空余的桌子了，除了午餐还有极个别之外。

transcript.en: Fortunately we've got our Head Chef back - he was away on holiday all last week which meant the other chefs had extra work.
transcript.zh: 幸运的是我们的主厨今天休完他的假期回来了，而他的假期意味着其他厨师需要额外加班。

transcript.en: Now, I'll tell you a bit more about the Job in a minute but first, some general regulations.
transcript.zh: 现在，我来简单地来说说关于这份工作的事情。

transcript.en: For all of you, whatever your age.
transcript.zh: 对于你们所有人来说，无论你们年龄多大，

transcript.en: there's some equipment you mustn't use until you've been properly trained,
transcript.zh: 对于你们所有人来说，无论你们年龄多大，有些设备是你们在接受足够的训练之前绝对不可以碰的，

transcript.en: like the waste disposal system for example, for health and safety reasons.
transcript.zh: 比如废物处理系统，这是为了健康和安全的考虑。

transcript.en: Then I think there are two of you here who are under 18-that's Emma and Jake. Isn't it?
transcript.zh: 你们当中好像有两个人未成年是吧，Emma和Jake是吧？

transcript.en: Right. so for you two, the meat slicer is out of bounds.
transcript.zh: 记着，你们两个人一定不要使用切肉机。

transcript.en: And of course none of you are allowed to use the electric mixer until you've been shown how it works.
transcript.zh: 还有，在有人给你们展示如何使用电力搅拌机之前，谁都不许动它。

transcript.en: Now you may have heard that this can be a stressful job,
transcript.zh: 听到这里你们可能会觉得这是一个很有压力的工作，

transcript.en: and I have to say that can be true.
transcript.zh: 我实话告诉你们，是的。

transcript.en: You'll be working an eight-hour day for the first week,
transcript.zh: 第一周你们每天要工作八小时。

transcript.en: though you'll have the chance to do overtime after that as well if you want to.
transcript.zh: 当然如果你们想的话，你们也可以加班。

transcript.en: But however long the hours are, you'll get a break in the middle.
transcript.zh: "但是不管工作时间有多长，你们中间都会有休息时间。

transcript.en: What you will find is that you're on your feet all day long. lifting and carrying.
transcript.zh: 你们的工作会是全天站着，不断的抬东西搬东西，

transcript.en: so if you're not fit now you soon will be!
transcript.zh: 如果你现在不适应，那么你迟早会的。

transcript.en: You'll find you don't have much chance to take it easy- when someone tells you to do something you need to do it straightaway but at least we do have a very efficient air conditioning system compared with some kitchens.
transcript.zh: 你们不会有闲暇的时候，当有人告诉你去做什么事情的时候你必须立刻完成，但至少咱们这里的制冷系统与其他餐厅比起来还是很高效的。

transcript.en: Now let me tell you about some of the people you need to know.
transcript.zh: 现在我来告诉你们一些你们需要认识的人。

transcript.en: So as I said,I'm Joy Parkins and I decide who does what during the day and how long they work for.
transcript.zh: 我之前说过，我叫Joy Perkins，由我决定一天中由谁做什么工作以及做多久。

transcript.en: I'll be trying to get you to work with as many different people in the kitchen as possible,
transcript.zh: 我会尽量让你们跟厨房里尽可能多的不同的人一起工作，

transcript.en: so that you learn while You're on the job.
transcript.zh: 这样你们就能在工作里学到东西。

transcript.en: One person whose name you must remember is David Field.
transcript.zh: 有一个人，他的名字你们一定要记住，他就是David Field.

transcript.en: If you injure yourself at all. even if it's really minor,
transcript.zh: 如果你们弄伤了自己，即使是很轻微的伤，

transcript.en: you must report to him and he'll make sure the incident is recorded and you get the appropriate treatment.
transcript.zh: 也要跟他报告，这样他就能确保记录下受伤事件，确保你们得到适当的处理。

transcript.en: He's trained to give basic treatment to Staff himself.
transcript.zh: 他接受过训练，可以对员工进行基本的伤情处理，

transcript.en: or he'll send you off somewhere else if necessary.
transcript.zh: 或者有必要的话，他会把你们送到别处去。

transcript.en: Then there's Dexter Wills-he's the person you need to see if you smash a plate or something like that.
transcript.zh: 接下来是Dexter Wills - 如果你们打碎了盘子之类的东西，他就是你们要见的人。

transcript.en: Don't just leave it and hope no one will notice-It's really important to get things noted and replaced or there could be problems later.
transcript.zh: 不要不管不顾，希望没人注意让打碎的东西被注意到并被更换是非常重要的，否则可能会有后续的问题。

transcript.en: And finally, there's Mike Smith.
transcript.zh: 最后，你们得认识Mike Smith.

transcript.en: He's the member of staff who takes care of all the stores of perishables.
transcript.zh: 他也是咱们员工中的一员，由他照看所有易耗品的库存情况，

transcript.en: so if you notice we're getting low in flour or sugar or something, make sure you let him know so he can put in an order.
transcript.zh: 所以如果你注意到我们的面粉或糖或者别的什么东西变少了，要确保让他知道，这样他就能去订货了。

transcript.en: OK, now the next thing…
transcript.zh: 好的，下面一件事情...
